schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Everything non-breaking lands in a single weekly PR — npm, bun, cargo and github-actions together. This is the whole point of moving off Dependabot, which opened one PR per package per directory.

Majors are never auto-raised: they wait as checkboxes on the Dependency Dashboard, so a breaking bump (typescript 7, eslint 10, bitcoinjs-lib 7, soroban-sdk 27) only becomes a PR once someone opts in.

soroban-sdk is pinned to the contracts' protocol floor: a major also raises the required Stellar CLI version and can change bn254/Poseidon host-function behaviour, so it must be reviewed by hand alongside contracts/deployments.
